content: 1. The combination of emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tamsulosin by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 2. The combination of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tamsulosin by inhibiting the hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 3. Cobicistat is a potent inhibitor of CYP2D6. Caution is advised when co-administering with CYP2D6 substrates, especially those associated with serious or life-threatening events due to elevated plasma concentrations. 4. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels or effects of tasimelteon by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 5. Tecovirimat decreases the plasma levels or effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 6. Tecovirimat is a weak inducer of CYP3A4. When co-administered, monitor the effectiveness of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. 7. Co-administration of teicoplanin and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the risk of nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor therapy. 8. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of temsirolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 9. Cobicistat is a potent inhibitor of CYP3A4 and is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that are associated with serious or life-threatening events due to elevated plasma concentrations. 10. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of teniposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 11. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels or effects of terbinafine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 12. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tetracycline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 13. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of theophylline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 14. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of thioridazine by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 15. Cobicistat is a potent inhibitor of CYP2D6. A dose reduction of the neuroleptic may be necessary when co-administered. 16. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tiagabine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 17. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of ticlopidine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 18. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of timolol by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 19. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tinidazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 20. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tisotumab vedotin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. MMAE, the active metabolite, is a CYP3A4 substrate, and co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic exposure and the risk of adverse effects. 21. Co-administration of tobramycin and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the risk of nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor therapy. 22. Co-administration of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF with tolmetin increases the toxicity of either drug by decreasing renal clearance. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 23. Toxicity may result from co-administration of emtricitabine and tenofovir with other drugs primarily excreted by glomerular filtration and/or active tubular secretion, including high-dose or multiple-dose NSAIDs. Alternatives to NSAIDs should be considered. 24. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tolterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 25. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF decreases the plasma levels of torsemide by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 26. Elvitegravir is a moderate inducer of CYP2C9. 27. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of tramadol by inhibiting both CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 28. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of trazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 29. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 30. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of triazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Consider reducing the benzodiazepine dose. 31. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of trimethoprim by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism but decreases its levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 32. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of trimipramine by inhibiting both CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 33. Ublituximab decreases the effects of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF through immunosuppressive effects, increasing the risk of infection. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 34. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 35. Co-administration of valacyclovir and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor therapy. 36. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of valbenazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Reduce the valbenazine dose to 40 mg once daily when co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 37. Co-administration of valganciclovir and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor therapy. 38. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vamorolone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Reduce the starting dose of vamorolone to 4 mg/kg/day, not exceeding 200 mg/day if weight >50 kg. 39. Co-administration of vancomycin and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Use caution and monitor therapy. 40. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vardenafil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Limit the dose to 5 mg in 72 hours. 41. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of venlafaxine by inhibiting both CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 42. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of verapamil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 43. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vilanterol/fluticasone furoate inhaled by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 44. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vilazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 45. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vinblastine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 46. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vincristine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 47. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of vinorelbine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 48. Co-administration of voriconazole and elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of each other by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 49. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF decreases the plasma levels of zafirlukast by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor therapy. 50. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of zanubrutinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. Reduce the zanubrutinib dose to 80 mg once daily when co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Adjust the dose as recommended for adverse reactions, and resume the previous dose after discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor. 51. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of zolpidem by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored. 52. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of zonisamide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified or closely monitored.
